dataQuality.summary: GST columns are shifted one column left.
dataQuality.detail: CF is headed 'GST @ 18%' but links to 'OPEX BOQ - Detail'!P (the Excl-GST total), and CG is headed 'Total - Incl. GST' but links to column Q (the GST amount). CF19 therefore reads Rs.6,917,661,679.69 where Rs.1,245,179,102.34 is meant. Executive Summary is unaffected because it computes GST itself as F7*18%. This platform computes GST from the ex-GST base, so its figures and its Excel export are correct.

dataQuality.summary: Schedule O1 'Manpower in Mobile Vans' breaks its 4% escalation in Year 3.
dataQuality.detail: Year 3 reads 3,959,612 against a Year 2 of 5,643,938, then jumps back to 6,104,484 in Year 4. Every other row in O1/O2 escalates cleanly, and this row's Track 2 twin (row 286) reads 5,869,696 in Year 3, which is exactly 5,643,938 x 1.04. The figure appears to understate by about Rs.19.1 lakh. Carried through as-is; a decision for the BOQ owner.
